def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full-width or full-height solid line separates two binary panels.
    split = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if split is not None:
        a, b = grid[:split], grid[split+1:]
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)]
                for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    split = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if split is not None:
        return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c+split+1] != 0 else 0
                 for c in range(split)] for r in range(h)]
    return grid
